title: Restrictions audit: measure human embark and mercenary-hire transport rounding separately
body:
Owner requests auditing plausible restrictions that became remake rules without exact original evidence, following the corrected negative-treasury funding assumption. This is a bounded question, not authority to generalize one caller to all transport paths.

Current [human embark branch](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/blob/4d70275aac4e155c0370a3ee23525cf34450a908/src/IC2.Engine/Naval/Commands/EmbarkArmyCommandHandler.cs#L85) compares totalTroops > ships*500; [HireMercenaryCommandHandler](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/blob/4d70275aac4e155c0370a3ee23525cf34450a908/src/IC2.Engine/Recruitment/Commands/HireMercenaryCommandHandler.cs#L181) uses the corresponding exact post-hire product. The [promoted refusal report](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/2026-10-05-refusal-texts-and-conditions.md) instead describes R06 as ships<troops/500 (dump46594), R27 as ships<(troops+unit)/500 (43648). Existing R06 play10700 against20/30ships cannot distinguish rounding; R27 was unplayed. Check later findings first.

The [army TRANSFER report U3/U3b](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial-conquest-2-research/blob/865755e04f107afc38cdb496669d882e2551aca6/docs/reports/2026-10-09-supply-providers-and-transfer-clamps.md) proves15499 accepted/15500 refused on30ships for that caller; corresponding implementation discrepancy is [build1489](https://github.com/diegoami/imperial_conquest_2/issues/1489). Do not assume human embark/hire are identical because they use the same divisor.

Experiments: ten ships with resulting total5000,5001,5499,5500 for HUMAN embark and mercenary hire separately. Keep all other gates valid (moves, purse, supply, offer location, ownership, selection, unit/army slots). Record dialog opening, controls, exact first refusal/admission, resulting troops and carrier links. Pair code traces and actual original controls. Distinguish pre-dialog R12 from per-offer R27 and any post-order overflow handling. Add one reverse/control case where no troop increase occurs if relevant.

Deliver exact per-caller arithmetic/rounding and evidence limits, EXE/runtime identity and reproducible controls. Preserve private artifacts and original inputs; publish no original bytes or private per-save hashes. Coordinate Windows runs without interrupting the owner. No remake changes or T216 AI allocation-policy redesign requested.
